title: ICAN G25 SL 700C gravel wheelset
notes: Official direct store, USD. G25 SL with D91 hubs: 50 mm depth, 25 mm inner and 31.3 mm outer width, hooked bead, clincher tubeless ready, recommended 700x35-50 mm tires and 29-60 mm usable; T700 carbon rim; D91 hub with 45T star ratchet; Sapim CX-Ray spokes 24/24 two-cross with Sapim alloy nipples; Center Lock, 12x100/12x142 mm; 1,352 g (636 g front, 716 g rear); 2-year guarantee. Variants: D91 steel bearings US$670 on sale (compare-at US$720-740), ceramic bearings US$730, DT Swiss 240 EXP hubs US$1,049 (1,370 g). Shimano HG, SRAM XDR and Shimano Micro Spline freehub variants are listed. No maximum tire pressure or load limit is published. Photo: the pair with G25 SL rim decals from the official gallery.
